article.title: GMOs and pesticide use (an email from Greg Conko)
article.excerpt: Here is a further Mark Bittman column on GMOs , arguing against GMOs on the grounds that they lead to greater use of chemicals and pesticides. I would start with quite a simple point, namely to the extent there is a problem with chemicals and pesticides (as there may be with or without GMOs), let’s regulate that problem directly.
